verdict.rationale: The dashboard's Optimize tool reads a completed Agent run's event history and suggests a better system prompt, and it can turn the run into a reusable Stagehand script. That is an in-product, AI-generated suggestion drawn from the user's own run data, but it is narrowly scoped to improving agent prompts and scripts rather than general insights. Missing for 10: general analytics or insights over session and run data, insights across multiple runs, any evidence of AI analysis of extracted data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: The Optimize tool lives in the Agent run view in the dashboard...reads the run's event history and helps you turn what the Agent did into a better system prompt.
Use the Optimize tool to turn a completed Agent run into a reusable Stagehand script.
